name: pre-v45-barn-drains-v1
description: 20/09/2026. THE QUESTION THIS ARM ANSWERS: reference-v21 (the v45 sheet pass) shows the barn filling up worse than any earlier version of this game - a typical barn holds 2.8 cards in the middle third of a game and 4.0 in the last third, a rise of +1.3, where every earlier version showed about +0.5. Two of the thirteen v45 retexts point straight at that, and both were in the same pass: V10 The Supply House used to read "Discard up to 2 cards from your Barn. For each card discarded, perform the base action of that crop" - a barn DRAIN - and now reads "For each card in your Barn, draw 1 of that suit" (R1), where nothing ever leaves the barn, so the drain is gone. V17 The Dockworker's Union used to read "Whenever you discard a card from your Barn, Draw 1" - a reward FOR draining the barn - and now reads "If, at the end of your turn, your Barn is empty, place any deck card into your Barn" (R5): a drain became a tap. Nobody has measured how much of the +0.5-to-+1.3 move is these two cards against how much is the rest of the v45 pass (the eleven other retexts) or the structural squeeze (V10's own new draw is itself a hand-pressure source, W16's condition, the Tier 3 cloggable conversion). THIS ARM ISOLATES EXACTLY THOSE TWO CARDS: it sets `rules.economy.supplyHouseBarnDrain` and `rules.economy.dockworkersUnionDrawOnDiscard` to their PRE-v45 values (true, true) and touches nothing else, so the arm is the shipped v45 game except for V10 and V17, which play exactly as they did before the retext (quoted verbatim off `git show e6b459c`, not rewritten from the old card text). Read it paired against the shipped default on identical reference-v21 seeds: any barn-glut movement it does NOT explain is the rest of v45 or the structural squeeze, not these two cards. ⚠️ NEITHER KNOB HAS A NOISE FLOOR OF ITS OWN and the project has no noise floor for the barn medians at all, so read any delta this arm produces against reference-v21's own noise floor (reports/noise-2026-09-19T23-05-03-reference-v21.txt) and say plainly when a movement is not distinguishable from chance. ⛔ WHAT THIS ARM DOES NOT TOUCH, BY DESIGN: R2-R4, R6-R10 (V10's draw stays mandatory and uncapped when its own new shape is read elsewhere, V12's free board power, W13's self-clog, W16's hand-only fresh-checked condition, A19/A20's caps) are untouched - this overlay pins only the two barn-drain leaves and inherits every other v45 default. It is not a full 'restore the pre-v45 game' arm and must not be read as one.
